dbi-services:max-pdbs-in-standard-editio: In 12.2 Standard Edition unexpectedly allows creating a second PDB via CON_ID>3, unlike 12.1's ORA-65010 block, so admins must explicitly set MAX_PDBS to 1.
dbi-services:database-is-more-than-persi: Argues that treating a database as an isolated per-developer 'persistence layer' container misses the point: sharing across concurrent users, not persistence, is what makes it hard.
dbi-services:archivelog-deletion-policy-: Shows that CONFIGURE ARCHIVELOG DELETION POLICY clause order matters: putting BACKED UP 1 TIMES TO DISK before APPLIED ON ALL STANDBY leaves archivelogs unreclaimable and fills the recovery area.
dbi-services:virtualbox-5-2-exports-the-: VirtualBox 5.2 can export a VM directly to an Oracle Cloud Compute image, producing per-disk tar.gz files containing raw .img disks later uploaded to Compute Classic.
dbi-services:oracle-database-multilingua: Benchmarks a recursive Euclid's GCD algorithm written in JavaScript and deployed via dbjs against an equivalent PL/SQL procedure to measure MLE's SQL-engine context-switch overhead.
dbi-services:odc-appreciation-day-javasc: Explains why Oracle's Multilingual Engine runs JavaScript compiled rather than interpreted in the database, correcting the author's earlier assumption that it mirrors browser-side execution.
dbi-services:autonomous-database: Distinguishes the marketing label from the underlying mechanisms of Oracle's Autonomous Database, tracing RAC and Data Guard availability features back to the Exadata Express Cloud Service.
dbi-services:oda-x7: Compares ODA X7-2S and X7-2M hardware specs against the X6 generation, noting the Small model adds KVM virtualization while cores, memory, and NVMe flash capacity increase on the Medium model.
dbi-services:oracle-18c-ru-and-rur-for-p: Categorizes DBA patching styles from conservative to pioneer to explain how the new Release Update and Release Update Revision model changes the calculus for adopting fixes.
dbi-services:_suppress_identifiers_on_du: Explains why the insert-then-catch-dup_val_on_index-then-update upsert pattern is unsafe under concurrency and why Oracle added an underscore parameter to accommodate SAP's use of it.
dbi-services:when-deterministic-function: Tests what happens when a function-based index is declared on a non-deterministic function, contrasting Oracle's in-place row updates with Postgres HOT/WARM's insert-and-mark-stale MVCC design.
dbi-services:am-i-a-dba-3-0-or-just-an-s: Challenges sweeping 'DBA 3.0' and 'death of the DBA' narratives by walking through the author's own career since 1994 to show how the role varies by company size and region.
dbi-services:wrong-result-with-multitena: Reproduces a dictionary bug where querying DBA_CONSTRAINTS after ALTER SESSION SET CURRENT_SCHEMA in a PDB returns constraints for the wrong owner, a multitenant dictionary-separation side effect.
dbi-services:active-data-guard-services-: Shows that a PDB registers the same default service name on both primary and standby, so DBAs must create distinct services per PDB to avoid two databases sharing one listener registration.
dbi-services:12c-access-control-lists: Walks through the simplified 12c syntax for granting network ACL privileges, showing the ORA-24247 error a non-SYS user hits with UTL_TCP before the access control list is assigned.
dbi-services:create-constraints-in-your-: Demonstrates on a 10-million-row fact table with three dimensions why declaring RELY NOVALIDATE foreign keys in a data warehouse avoids ETL overhead while still helping the optimizer.
dbi-services:impdp-contentmetadata_only-: Confirms that Data Pump import with content=metadata_only has locked table statistics since 10.2, stopping the auto stats gathering job from overwriting them with zero rows after migration.
dbi-services:12c-dbms_stats-gather_table: Tests whether DBMS_STATS.GATHER_TABLE_STATS commits a transaction when run on a global temporary table with private session statistics, correcting an 11g assumption carried into 12c.
dbi-services:when-pdb-name-conflicts-wit: Recommends naming a PDB the way you would name a standalone database, and warns against giving a single-tenant CDB and its one PDB the same name because of listener service-name collisions.
dbi-services:postgres-vs-oracle-access-p: Runs a Postgres Sample Scan with TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI(5) on a 10000-row table and shows it still reads all 1429 pages, because random sampling needs to know the row count before picking 5%.
Compares an Oracle ROWID and a Postgres TID for the same row, decoding file, block, and row offset from each, before showing how an UPDATE changes the row's physical location.
Decomposes how Oracle's TABLE ACCESS BY ROWID and Postgres's equivalent Tid Scan fetch a row once the index entry supplies its 10-byte ROWID or its (block,offset) TID.
dbi-services:improving-statspack-experie: Shares a DBMS_SCHEDULER script, contributed by a colleague, that replaces the author's older DBMS_JOB-based statspack.snap and statspack.purge scheduling across each RAC instance.
dbi-services:bequeath-connect-to-pdb-set: Warns against the workaround of creating a common user with a logon trigger that runs ALTER SESSION SET CONTAINER to fake a bequeath connection into a PDB, since it needs a common_user_prefix change.
dbi-services:get-trace-file-from-server-: Shares a SQL*Plus script that reads a trace file through UTL_FILE and DBMS_OUTPUT and spools it to the client, useful when the DBA has no filesystem access to the server.
dbi-services:postgres-vs-oracle-access-p: Adds a condition that eliminates all rows via the index but still needs a table lookup for extra columns, comparing Postgres's Index Scan with Filter to the equivalent Oracle access path.
dbi-services:oda-x6-small-medium-large-a: Lists the core counts, rack units, and USB/serial console details distinguishing the ODA X6-2S, 2M, 2L, and 2-node HA appliance models.
dbi-services:postgres-vs-oracle-access-p: Runs the same one-row lookup after VACUUM to show Postgres switching from Index Only Scan to Index Scan once an unindexed column is selected, forcing an extra heap fetch.
Compares Oracle's FIRST_ROWS costing and Postgres's startup-cost model for queries that only need the first rows, using an ORDER BY on an indexed column to avoid a blocking sort.
Extends an earlier Index Full Scan demo with an ORDER BY, contrasting how Oracle threads visibility checks through undo with Postgres's index-order-only leaf traversal.
dbi-services:exadata-capacity-on-demand-: Tabulates the minimum, maximum, and increment core counts for Capacity on Demand across Exadata X2 through X7 models, sourced from the OEDA configuration file, including 1/8 Rack exceptions.
dbi-services:postgres-vs-oracle-access-p: Shows that summing an indexed column triggers an Index Only Scan in Postgres but a full table scan in Oracle unless hinted, because Oracle index entries alone can't satisfy visibility checks.
Explains that Postgres MVCC visibility applies only to table tuples while Oracle's applies to index blocks too, which is why an index-only query can still force Oracle into a sequential scan.
dbi-services:oracle-cloud-script-to-stop: Provides a curl-and-jq shell script against the Oracle Cloud REST API that queries all non-stopped PaaS service instances and stops them, useful for cutting metered cloud costs overnight.
dbi-services:display-data-guard-configur: Shows SQL Developer 17.2's new DBA-view Data Guard display and uses it to illustrate cascading redo shipping across two standby databases with independent LogXptMode settings.
dbi-services:postgres-vs-oracle-access-p: Creates a 10000-row, 1429-page demo table to show Postgres's seq_page_cost constant driving the cost of a full sequential scan, kicking off a comparison series with Oracle access paths.
dbi-services:postgres-unique-constraint: Uses a primary-key update tweet as a starting point to examine how Postgres and Oracle each validate a unique constraint when two rows swap values within a single transaction.
dbi-services:postgres-vs-oracle-access-p: Opens a series comparing Postgres query-planning terminology, pages, tuples, relations, with Oracle's blocks, rows, tables, stating the intent to learn Postgres from an Oracle DBA's perspective.
dbi-services:postgresql-on-cygwin: Installs PostgreSQL through the Cygwin package manager on Windows 10 rather than a Linux VM, covering the pg_config dependency and setting up Cygserver to run it as a Windows service.
dbi-services:postgres-vs-oracle-access-p: Contrasts a well-clustered index scan reading about 150 blocks for 1000 rows with the worst-case clustering factor that forces Postgres into a Bitmap Index Scan to reduce block re-reads.
dbi-services:oda-x6-installation-re-imag: Gives a cheat sheet for re-imaging a freshly racked Oracle Database Appliance through the ILOM management network interface before the public network is configured.
dbi-services:12c-multitenant-internals-v: Explains that V$ fixed views, unlike dictionary views, have no metadata to link and instead rely on CON_ID filtering so they remain queryable even in NOMOUNT or MOUNT state.
dbi-services:12cr2-application-container: Reproduces bug 21955394 where a foreign key in an application PDB referencing a root data-link table fails a DELETE with ORA-02291 because parent-key lookup only checks the current container.
dbi-services:12c-nssn-process-for-data-g: Confirms by ps -edf that Oracle spawns one NSSn background process per LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n destination configured for SYNC redo transport, matching the destination numbers.
dbi-services:12cr2-pdb-refresh-as-a-poor: Tests whether a refreshable PDB, which ships and applies redo to sync datafiles, could substitute for disaster recovery, concluding it's unsupported for production so far.
dbi-services:12cr2-auditing-all-users-wi: Shows the new 12.2 unified audit syntax auditing users by granted role, letting a single policy automatically cover every user later granted the DBA role.
dbi-services:new-release-model-for-jul17: Tracks evolving rumors and confirmed bug references to predict the version number and release date of Oracle's new annual Release Update model ahead of its official announcement.
dbi-services:oracle-12cr2-exchange-parti: Shows that EXCHANGE PARTITION can use the same rolling cursor invalidation as DBMS_STATS, but only when the exchanged table has matching indexes, else invalidation is immediate.
dbi-services:which-privilege-for-create-: Clarifies that remote PDB cloning needs CREATE SESSION on the source CDB plus either CREATE PLUGGABLE DATABASE or the undocumented SYSOPER privilege granted locally on the source PDB.
dbi-services:12cr2-needs-to-connect-with: Shows that CONTAINERS() DML relies on an implicit database link requiring a password, so connecting AS SYSDBA without one raises ORA-01017 unlike CONTAINERS() queries.
dbi-services:random-ora-01017-invalid-us: Traces intermittent ORA-01017 errors on 12.2.0.1 sysdba logins in a VirtualBox training lab to entropy starvation in /dev/random, absent when connecting to 12.1.0.2 instead.
dbi-services:12cr2-cross-container-dml-i: Demonstrates INSERT INTO CONTAINERS(table) from CDB$ROOT writing directly into a table in a specific PDB by CON_ID, one of the new documented cross-PDB DML operations in 12.2.
dbi-services:what-is-in-a-transportable-: Runs expdp with transport_tablespaces to show that a transportable-tablespace dump file holds only metadata objects like PLUGTS_BLK and constraints, not the actual data blocks.
dbi-services:can-you-open-pdbseed-read-w: Explains that PDB$SEED can only be opened read-write yourself in 12.2 local-undo mode to customize its UNDO tablespace, otherwise ALTER PLUGGABLE DATABASE PDB$SEED OPEN FORCE raises ORA-65017.
dbi-services:12c-nologging-and-data-guar: Shows how to disable force logging temporarily during a Data Pump import to cut migration downtime, then re-enable it and resynchronize the standby's nonlogged blocks afterward.
dbi-services:12cr2-partial-pdb-backup: Demonstrates that a partial PDB backup in 12.1 cannot be restored without the CDB$ROOT since rollback needs the shared UNDO tablespace, while 12.2 local UNDO removes that requirement.
dbi-services:listener-and-virtual-ip: Explains that a listener bound to the hostname in /etc/hosts already listens on all interfaces including the VIP, so a separate VIP-specific listener.ora entry is unnecessary unless an IP is explicit.
dbi-services:12cr2-rman-repair: Shows that RMAN's REPAIR command in 12.2 accepts direct targets like FAILURE, DATAFILE, or CORRUPTION beyond the 12.1.0.2 REPAIR FAILURE syntax, discoverable via the RMAN-01008 error text.
dbi-services:data-pump-logtime-dumpfile-: Diffs the impdp help output between 12.1 and 12.2 to highlight enhancements to the LOGTIME, DUMPFILE, PARFILE and DATA_PUMP_DIR parameters carried over from 12.1.
dbi-services:securefiles-on-multi-datafi: Reproduces uneven datafile filling in a multi-datafile tablespace during an 11g-to-12c migration, traced to LOB segments converted to SecureFiles with transform=lob_storage:securefile.
dbi-services:sqlcl-on-bash-on-ubuntu-on-: Sets up SQLcl inside the Windows Subsystem for Linux (Bash on Ubuntu) after the Windows 10 Creators Update, comparing the experience to running the same tool under Cygwin.
dbi-services:service-696c6f76656d756c746: Decodes a cryptic hex-named listener service registered per PDB in 12.2 as the PDB's GUID, an internal service used for features like Proxy PDB that should not be used for client connections.
dbi-services:12cr2-dml-monitoring-and-st: Enables an undocumented DBMS_STATS trace bit to watch the MMON slave trace and reveal how the 12.2 Statistics Advisor tracks DML frequency to detect volatile tables for stats locking.
dbi-services:12cr2-dbca-automatic-memory: Explains the DBT-11211/INS-35178 error blocking Automatic Memory Management above 4GB physical memory in 12.2, contrasting it with sizing SGA and PGA separately under ASMM.
dbi-services:when-automatic-reoptimizati: Shows a case where 12c auto-reoptimization based on cardinality feedback produces a worse plan on the second execution before self-correcting back to the original fast plan by the fourth.
dbi-services:jan17-proactive-bundle-patc: Recommends the latest 12.1 patchset plus the January 2017 Proactive Bundle Patch and two specific patches needed to fully control Adaptive Statistics before a migration.
dbi-services:purging-unified-audit-trail: Traces the 12.2 unified audit purge and finds it now checks IS_DROPPABLE_PARTITION on the partitioned AUD$UNIFIED table, letting old records be dropped instead of a slow row-by-row delete.
dbi-services:how-many-members-for-standb: Argues that the traditional two-member redo log recommendation still protects against file loss, and explains why standby redo logs are only written to, not read, until a role transition.
dbi-services:oracle-12cr2-on-windows-vir: Explains Windows 2008 R2's Virtual Accounts as a new install-time option for the process running Oracle 12.2, avoiding the password-management overhead of the 12.1 Oracle Home User.
dbi-services:google-cloud-platform-insta: Benchmarks Google Cloud IaaS instance types with a cached SLOB workload, while noting that Oracle currently refuses to count Google Cloud vCPUs as an authorized licensing metric.
dbi-services:12cr2-tns_admin-in-env-ora: Shows that the new 12.2 $ORACLE_HOME/env.ora file lets you redirect TNS_ADMIN to a shared network directory without symbolic links, verified with strace tracing which sqlnet.ora tnsping opens.
dbi-services:oracle-12cr2-rac-cloud-acfs: Hits an ORA-28357/ORA-17517 wallet and storage-snapshot failure when creating a PDB as a snapshot copy on ACFS in the Oracle Public Cloud, traced to the TDE keystore password requirement.
dbi-services:oracle-12cr2-changes-for-lo: Shows that 12.2 stops running login.sql from the current working directory as a security fix, tracing with bash -x how SQL*Plus resolves the script path differently than in 12.1.
dbi-services:misleading-wait-event-names: Highlights the new DISPLAY_NAME column added to V$EVENT_NAME in 12c, listing several internally-named wait events whose display name better matches user-facing meaning.
dbi-services:purging-unified-audit-trail: Traces DBMS_AUDIT_MGMT.CLEAN_AUDIT_TRAIL on a 12.1 Unified Audit Trail filled with hundreds of thousands of failed logins to determine whether the purge does slow deletes or fast truncates.
dbi-services:oracle-12cr2-online-tablesp: Runs a four-phase SLOB workload while encrypting and decrypting a tablespace online in 12.2, using ASH visualization to show the extra 'db file parallel write' overhead during each transition.
dbi-services:12cr2-recover-nonlogged-blo: Demonstrates the 12.2 RECOVER DATABASE NONLOGGED BLOCK command that lets a standby fetch and apply blocks left unrecoverable by a NOLOGGING direct-path insert on primary.
dbi-services:12c-unified-auditing-and-au: Explains that enabling the old AUDIT_TRAIL=DB parameter alongside Unified Auditing puts a 12c database into 'mixed mode', where V$OPTION still reports Unified Auditing as FALSE.
dbi-services:12cr2-lockdown-profiles-and: Reproduces losing a PDB datafile in a lab, showing the ORA-01113/ORA-01157 sequence when opening the CDB and the steps taken to offline the tablespace so the rest of the database can open.
dbi-services:12cr2-real-time-materialize: Demonstrates 12.2's on-query computation feature where a stale materialized view is joined with its materialized view log at query time to deliver a fresh result without a refresh.
dbi-services:12cr2-dbca-can-create-a-sta: Tests the new 'dbca -silent -createDuplicateDB -createAsStandby' option in 12.2, finding it fails with DBT-16056/DBT-16057 because it only supports single-instance, non-container databases.
dbi-services:oracle-public-cloud-liops-w: Reruns a cached SLOB logical-reads benchmark on Oracle PaaS DBaaS with a different CPU model than an earlier IaaS test, comparing logical I/O throughput per OCPU across the two service types.
dbi-services:oracle-public-cloud-2-ocpu-: Runs cached SLOB on an Oracle Public Cloud OC5 shape offering 2 OCPUs per processor license, comparing the resulting logical-read throughput to an earlier AWS bring-your-own-license test.
dbi-services:exadata-express-cloud-servi: Shows how to read a SQL trace or optimizer 10053 trace on the filesystem-less Exadata Express Cloud Service by querying V$DIAG_TRACE_FILE_CONTENTS for the session's trace file.
dbi-services:oracle-public-cloud-12cr2-t: Explains the encrypt_new_tablespaces parameter, defaulting to CLOUD_ONLY, that forces every new Oracle Public Cloud tablespace to be TDE-encrypted regardless of the CREATE TABLESPACE DDL.
dbi-services:cbo-parse-time-match-time-w: Uses a 10053 trace enhanced by an April 2016 PSU bug fix to annotate accumulated CPU and elapsed parse time against specific query-transformation phases like join predicate pushdown.
dbi-services:exadata-express-cloud-servi: Shows that creating a tablespace in the PDBaaS Exadata Express Cloud Service inherits db_create_file_dest from the CDB administrator and raises ORA-65250 if a datafile path is specified.
dbi-services:running-slob-on-exadata-exp: Runs the SLOB benchmark remotely against Exadata Express Cloud Service using the client credentials wallet and TNS_ADMIN over SQL*Net-over-SSL, without SYSDBA or host access.
dbi-services:amazon-aws-instances-and-or: Compares cached SLOB logical-reads-per-second across AWS T2, M4, R4 and C4 instance types under a 2-processor-license vCPU budget to find the best-performing shape for bring-your-own-license Oracle.
dbi-services:oracle-core-factor-and-non-: Walks through Oracle's Processor Core Factor Table and cloud licensing documents to explain how to count AWS vCPUs, Azure cores, and other cloud or virtualized CPUs against a processor license.
dbi-services:exadata-express-cloud-servi: Runs a recursive DBA_ROLE_PRIVS query to enumerate which system privileges the PDB_ADMIN user actually holds through its PDB_DBA role on the Exadata Express Cloud Service.
dbi-services:12cr2-no-cardinality-feedba: Uses strings against the oracle binary to trace bug 23596611, which bypasses 12c cardinality feedback re-optimization for queries classified internally as 'small', a change not yet documented.
dbi-services:nls-defaults-for-language-a: Lists, for every value in V$NLS_VALID_VALUES, the derived NLS_DATE_FORMAT, NLS_NUMERIC_CHARACTERS and NLS_CURRENCY defaults set when NLS_TERRITORY or NLS_LANGUAGE is changed.
dbi-services:oracle-12cr2-awr-views-in-m: Maps which AWR dictionary views read from CDB-level snapshots, PDB-level snapshots, or both in 12.2, now that AWR snapshots can be taken at either the CDB or PDB level.
dbi-services:rman-transport-tablespace: Shows RMAN's TRANSPORT TABLESPACE command restoring a tablespace via TSPITR into an auxiliary instance so it can be exported without the source going read-only, and why it can't run from a PDB.
dbi-services:oracle-database-12c-release: Recounts co-authoring the Oracle Press multitenant book with two colleagues, describing the technical and English-language review process with additional named reviewers.
dbi-services:oracle-12cr2-statistics-adv: Summarizes the V$STATS_ADVISOR_RULES catalog, walking through best-practice rules such as always enabling the automatic statistics job and purging statistics history from SYSAUX.
dbi-services:multitenant-internals-summa: Indexes the author's series of multitenant-internals posts covering metadata links, object links, AWR views, dictionary upgrades, and shared-pool row cache behavior in CDB/PDB separation.
dbi-services:histograms-on-character-str: Shows that a frequency histogram gathered in 11.2.0.3 produces a wrong low-cardinality estimate under the 11.2.0.4 optimizer's out-of-range predicate density calculation for a two-value flag column.
dbi-services:encryption-in-oracle-public: Explains the ORA-28374 typed-master-key error hit when creating a tablespace in a new PDB on Oracle Public Cloud, tracing it to Transparent Data Encryption being enforced without option in DBaaS.
dbi-services:observing-dml-restarts-caus: Reproduces a DML restart on a hash-partitioned table by invalidating a cursor after it acquired a partition lock, showing the restart appears as a separate EXEC_SQL_ID in SQL Monitoring.
dbi-services:12cr2-upgrade-by-remote-clo: Walks through exporting and importing TDE encryption keys with ADMINISTER KEY MANAGEMENT so a 12.1 PDB's encrypted tablespaces stay readable after remote-cloning it into a 12.2 DBaaS service.
Diagnoses ORA-17628/ORA-17630 remote-file-protocol version mismatch when remote-cloning a 12.1 PDB directly into a 12.2 CDB, and shows the workaround needed in DBaaS.
dbi-services:12cr2-how-long-to-upgrade-a: Times a full CDB$ROOT catalog upgrade from 12.1.0.2 to 12.2.0.1 component by component to establish a baseline before comparing it to the elapsed time of upgrading a PDB by unplug/plug.
dbi-services:12cr2-upgrade-by-unplugplug: Demonstrates unplugging a PDB from a 12.1 DBaaS service, copying the datafiles and XML metadata over scp, and plugging it into a new 12.2 DBaaS service since no in-place upgrade button exists.
dbi-services:12cr2-create_file_dest-for-: Shows the new 12.2 CREATE_FILE_DEST clause on CREATE PLUGGABLE DATABASE that constrains a PDB's datafiles to a specific directory, fulfilling an OTN enhancement request filed two years earlier.
dbi-services:12cr2-single-tenant-multite: Shares Oracle Open World slides arguing that since non-CDB is deprecated, Single-Tenant still brings dictionary separation, PDB cloning, and metadata links to editions without the option.
dbi-services:12cr2-new-index-usage-track: Compares the improved 12.2 DBA_INDEX_USAGE and V$INDEX_USAGE_INFO views against older index monitoring, showing an undocumented parameter switching collection from sampled to all executions.
dbi-services:12cr2-has-new-sqlplus-featu: Lists small 12.2 SQL*Plus improvements: the default _EDITOR changes from 'ed' to 'vi', command-line history is added, and row/LOB prefetch plus statement caching become configurable.
dbi-services:oracle-12cr2-max_pdbs: Shows that MAX_PDBS, defaulting to 4098, is the only way in plain Enterprise Edition to cap pluggable database count below the option's 4096 limit, since Standard Edition enforces a hard cap.
dbi-services:oracle-12cr2-pluggable-data: Demonstrates PDB relocation between two Standard Edition CDBs with no option required, transporting a table's data without exporting metadata logically or setting the source tablespace read-only.
dbi-services:oracle-12cr2-multitenant-co: Shows that a 12.2 SQL trace now records a CONTAINER ID line at session start and on each implicit container switch, a detail missing from 12.1 traces of the same metadata-link queries.
dbi-services:oracle-12cr2-multitenant-lo: Explains why the shared CDB-level UNDO tablespace, despite dictionary separation putting user data in the PDB, is the reason PDBs can't be flashed back without an auxiliary instance in 12.1.
dbi-services:oracle-12cr2-plsql-new-feat: Introduces the 12.2 DBMS_TNS package that resolves a connection string from inside PL/SQL, avoiding the need to run tnsping on the server with matching TNS_ADMIN settings.
dbi-services:oracle-public-cloud-create-: Shows a JSON request body and curl REST API call against the Oracle Public Cloud service catalog to automate DBaaS provisioning from the command line instead of the web console.
dbi-services:dbvisit-replicate-when-you-: Explains why flashing back a Dbvisit Replicate target database doesn't break ongoing APPLY, since the MINE and APPLY configurations are stored separately in the source and destination.
dbi-services:12c-online-move-datafile-in: Uses strace to contrast a plain Linux 'mv' within a filesystem, a fast rename() with no copy, against Oracle's 12c online datafile move, which always physically copies even on the same filesystem.
dbi-services:12c-gtt-private-statistics-: Shows that gathering statistics on a global temporary table with session-scoped private statistics triggers immediate, not rolling, cursor invalidation, risking a hard-parse storm.
dbi-services:2-x-oda-x6-2s-dbvisit-stand: Documents pairing two ODA X6-2S appliances running Standard Edition with Dbvisit Standby across two datacenters, noting how odacli logs each provisioning step to a Java DB repository.
dbi-services:easy-datawarehouse-ods-load: Shows transporting tables into a datawarehouse ODS from a Data Guard snapshot standby using transportable tablespaces, avoiding the need to put the live production tablespace read-only.
dbi-services:cdb-resource-plan-shares-an: Explains CDB resource plan shares and utilization_limit as CPU-governing mechanisms in multitenant, demonstrating with 8 CPU-bound sessions how a 50% resource_limit caps one PDB.
dbi-services:oracle-12cr2-ddl-deferred-i: Reproduces a hang caused by ALTER TABLE ADD COMMENT invalidating dependent cursors, then shows 12.2's DDL deferred invalidation applying the rolling-invalidation window used by DBMS_STATS.
dbi-services:oracle-12cr2-is_rolling_inv: Adds a parse-only DBMS_SQL call to show the new IS_ROLLING_INVALID column in 12.2's V$SQL, distinguishing a cursor marked 'rolling invalid' from one already 'rolling invalid executed'.
dbi-services:modern-software-architectur: Argues to a developer audience that a relational database's role goes beyond persistence, tracing the author's path from OO design and RAD tools back to SQL as the technology that persisted.
dbi-services:ravello: Describes Ravello, acquired by Oracle earlier that year, as a nested-virtualization layer that imports VMware VM ecosystems and reproduces their private network, including original IP addresses.
dbi-services:oracle-12cr2-optimizer-adap: Distinguishes fixing the root cause of 12c adaptive-feature regressions from the common workaround of setting optimizer_features_enable to an older version, previewing 12.2 changes.
dbi-services:oracle-12cr2-long-identifie: Shows that while 12.1's dictionary views already used 128-byte VARCHAR2 columns, only 12.2 actually lifts the 30-character object-identifier limit, since 12.1 still raises ORA-00972.
dbi-services:oracle-database-12-2-pdbaas: Announces Exadata Express Cloud Service as the 'Cloud First' way to access 12.2 features, a fully-managed single-PDB service with no free trial and several system-level operations locked down.
dbi-services:oracle-12cr2-sql-new-featur: Shows the ORA-01489 string-too-long error LISTAGG raises past 4000 characters, then demonstrates 12.2's new ON OVERFLOW TRUNCATE clause replacing a manual cumulative-length workaround.
dbi-services:result-cache-side-effects-o: Demonstrates that a RESULT_CACHE-hinted query calls its underlying function twice on a cache miss instead of once, an overhead that matters when the cached function is itself expensive.
dbi-services:multitenant-thin-provisioni: Traces how ACFS snapshot-based thin cloning works for whole databases on ODA X5 versus PDB-level snapshot cloning in multitenant, and why a CDB itself cannot be created on a snapshot.
dbi-services:adaptive-plans-and-cost-of-: Investigates a tweeted execution-plan screenshot with mismatched cost numbers, reproducing a hash join with stale statistics to explain how Adaptive Plans cost their inactive branch alternative.
dbi-services:rolling-invalidate-window-e: Reproduces a hard-parse-storm postmortem by tracing V$SQL_SHARED_CURSOR.REASON timestamps for a rolling invalidate window exceeded, after a row insert changes a table's online-gathered num_rows.
dbi-services:filenames-in-awr-reports: Traces mismatched datafile names in AWR reports back to DBA_HIST_DATAFILE lacking a SNAP_ID, meaning AWR does not track filename history when a datafile moves between ACFS and ASM.
dbi-services:oda-x6-database-classes-and: Documents the odacli create-database command-line options on ODA X6, listing the OLTP/DSS/IMDB database classes and odb1-style shapes available for provisioning.
dbi-services:oda-x6-command-line-and-web: Shows the odacli describe-appliance output and small web console on ODA X6, covering appliance information, disk group redundancy percentages, and provisioning job history.
dbi-services:audit_sys_operations-and-to: Shows that AUDIT_SYS_OPERATIONS, despite documentation limiting it to top-level SYSDBA statements, also logs recursive statements from the automatic statistics job, flooding the audit trail.
dbi-services:unplugged-pluggable-databas: Critiques the Oracle documentation's USB-stick illustration of pluggable databases, arguing CDB$ROOT, PDB$SEED and user PDBs are all containers plugged into the CDB, not into CDB$ROOT.
dbi-services:multitenant-internals-objec: Shows that a query on a shared=object view over a fixed table like V$SESSION switches to CDB$ROOT using a RESULT_CACHE(SYSOBJ=TRUE) hint, explaining an observed refresh delay.
dbi-services:multitenant-internals-how-o: Traces the SQL trace of a query on an object-link view, showing it parses locally in the PDB but the recursive query against the CDB$ROOT copy of the table executes in a separate step.
dbi-services:exadata-x-5-bare-metal-vs-o: Runs a 50-session SLOB update workload comparing Exadata X5 Bare Metal against OVM virtualized, finding redo size, logical reads and IO request rates close enough to show minimal overhead.
dbi-services:oracle-serializable-is-not-: Reproduces a write-skew anomaly on SCOTT.EMP where two SERIALIZABLE transactions each independently validate a department salary total and update different employees concurrently.
dbi-services:exadata-x-5-bare-metal-vs-o: Compares single-thread cached SLOB performance between a 36-core Exadata X5 Bare Metal node and a 4-vCPU OVM guest to gauge licensing-relevant CPU overhead from virtualization.
dbi-services:large-pages-and-memory_targ: Shows that on Windows with Automatic Memory Management, SGA_MAX_SIZE, if set, is what gets allocated as large pages at startup regardless of MEMORY_MAX_SIZE, verified with RAMMap screenshots.
dbi-services:redo-log-block-size-on-oda: Tests 512-byte versus 4k redo log block sizes on ODA X6 all-flash storage, showing the ORA-01378 error the 512-byte-sector disk group raises until an override parameter is set.
dbi-services:oda-x-6-log-file-sync-with-: Runs a 10-session insert-and-commit workload on ODA X6 NVMe flash storage, showing 'log file sync' waits eating roughly 30% of DB time despite low absolute redo write latency.
dbi-services:amm-and-asmm-derived-parame: Answers whether PGA_AGGREGATE_LIMIT recalculates dynamically under Automatic Memory Management by querying internal parameters, showing it tracks 200% of the current pga_aggregate_target.
dbi-services:oracle-public-cloud-patch-c: Diagnoses an unexpected ORA-65010 pluggable-database limit hit on an 'EE Extreme Performance' Oracle Public Cloud service after applying a specific patch, then reproduces the conflict.
dbi-services:nulls-in-composite-keys: Demonstrates that a composite unique constraint allows repeated rows once any column is NULL for one of them, since a partially-null composite key is treated differently than a full duplicate.
dbi-services:oracle-multitenant-feature-: Proposes calling the set of dictionary-separation, unplug/plug, and metadata-link features available in every edition 'CDB architecture' rather than 'multitenant', a term tied to the paid option.
dbi-services:compare-source-and-target-i: Shows using Dbvisit Replicate's heartbeat table together with Oracle flashback query to compare row counts between a continuously changing source and its logical replication target.
dbi-services:script-to-suggest-fk-indexe: Shares a script that recommends adding a foreign-key index only where blocking TM Share locks have actually been observed on the child table, rather than indexing every foreign key reactively.
dbi-services:statspack-idle-events: Shows a Statspack 'Top 5 Timed Events' report dominated by background idle waits like 'LGWR worker group idle', explaining that Statspack's idle-event exclusion list hasn't kept up with newer events.
dbi-services:question-is-upgrade-now-to-: Argues, citing the Release Schedule of Current Database Releases note, that waiting up to a year for 12.2's on-premises release and first Bundle Patch is not a real risk for most customers.
dbi-services:oda-x6-2s-2m-for-ee-and-se: Announces the ODA X6-2S and X6-2M as the first Oracle Database Appliance models supporting Standard Edition 2 on dedicated hardware, aimed at customers previously limited to a Guest VM install.
dbi-services:adaptive-plans-and-sql-base: Reproduces a known interaction where capturing SQL Plan Baselines against an Adaptive Plan can cause regressions in 12.1, building a droppable test case with two demo tables.
dbi-services:ora-01775-looping-chain-of-: Shows that querying through a PUBLIC SYNONYM for a nonexistent object raises ORA-00942 only when read, and demonstrates how same-named tables and synonyms resolve differently by connecting user.
dbi-services:when-changing-cursor_sharin: Tests when a CURSOR_SHARING=FORCE system-level change actually takes effect, showing an existing literal-text query keeps its original predicate even after a fresh session and disabled cursor caching.
dbi-services:asm-iostats: Points to a Perl script by a colleague that queries the ASM instance for I/O bandwidth, IOPS, and latency statistics from the command line, comparing screenshots against an XtremIO storage console.
dbi-services:12c-online-datafile-move-an: Shows that manually resizing a datafile mid-move raises ORA-63000, but autoextension during the move triggers an automatic resize of the in-progress target file recorded in the alert.log.
dbi-services:large-pages-on-windows: Shows enabling ORA_LPENABLE at the instance level via Windows registry keys, stopping and restarting the Oracle service to confirm large pages apply without affecting a shared ASM instance.
dbi-services:instance-caging-and-multite: Runs 16 CPU-bound sessions in a multitenant CDB$ROOT to show that setting CPU_COUNT alone without a resource manager plan leaves instance caging unpredictable outside the maintenance window.
dbi-services:oracle-on-windows-server-co: Installs Oracle Database on Windows Server Core, showing that despite the OS having no GUI shell, the setup.exe and DBCA installer windows still run and complete a working listener and database.
dbi-services:where-is-the-asm-spfile: Lists the different ways to locate the ASM SPFILE, from asmcmd spget and SQL*Plus show parameter when the instance is up, to searching all diskgroups with asmcmd find when it is not.
dbi-services:learning-and-troubleshootin: Traces how a simple table row read resolves down through SYS.TAB$, the segment header's TS#/FILE#/BLOCK#, and the dcore.bsq bootstrap definitions to the physical block on disk.
dbi-services:extended-clusters-and-asm_p: Tests the asm_preferred_read_failure_groups parameter on an extended cluster with sub-millisecond inter-site latency, comparing wait-time histograms with local-read preference enabled.
dbi-services:db_flashback_retention_targ: Shows a case where a primary database hangs because its Fast Recovery Area is full, despite showing 0% used, since the archivelog deletion policy required standby confirmation that never arrived.
dbi-services:which-patchset-for-12-1-0-2: Clarifies which of the two 12.1.0.2 patchset downloads to use, explaining that one is superseded and the other is the one that actually enables Standard Edition 2 installation.
dbi-services:sys-password-on-oracle-clou: Explains that the DBaaS administration password provided at creation becomes the hashed SYS/SYSTEM password rather than being stored in clear, distinguishing it from the VM's SSH key access.
dbi-services:data-guard-as-a-service: Shows enabling the 'Standby Database with Data Guard' checkbox on Oracle Public Cloud DBaaS creation, provisioning two VMs and an automatically configured broker achieving SYNC transport.
dbi-services:multitenant-dictionary-what: Builds a query counting rows in every ORACLE_MAINTAINED dictionary table across CDB$ROOT and PDB$SEED to empirically verify how much system metadata is actually stored only at the root.
dbi-services:adaptive-plan-how-much-can-: Empirically probes the row-buffering limit of the 12c Adaptive Plan STATISTICS COLLECTOR operation, inserting increasing row counts to find where the alternative join method activates.
dbi-services:when-a-query-has-read-350tb: Diagnoses a SQL Monitor report showing 350TB read from only 5GB of actual data, tracing it to a nested loop with 21 million iterations and 73,000 repeated full table scans.
dbi-services:testing-oracle-on-exoscale-: Provisions a trial IaaS instance on the Swiss cloud host exoscale.ch, installing Oracle Database on CentOS to later run SLOB and monitor performance with Orachrome Lighty.
dbi-services:can-you-become-a-paas-provi: Explains the licensing constraints around hosting Oracle Database as a service, contrasting the Oracle Public Cloud, Oracle Cloud Machine, and Authorized Cloud Environment routes.
dbi-services:io-performance-predictabili: Shows a SLOB workload on Oracle Cloud Service IO whose runtime unexpectedly grows past its fixed WORK_LOOP over several hours one Sunday, traced with ASH visualization to rising I/O latency.
dbi-services:a-short-glance-at-attunity-: Trials Attunity Replicate's bulk-reader, CDC and stream-loader architecture against a single EMP2 table, comparing its GUI-driven setup to the author's usual Dbvisit Replicate experience.
dbi-services:transparently-externalize-b: Prototypes converting BLOB columns to external BFILE storage to keep large document growth out of the database, testing whether the change can remain transparent to the querying application.
dbi-services:single-tenant-vs-non-cdb-no: Measures the extra datafile storage and process overhead of a single-tenant CDB against an equivalent non-CDB database on identical Oracle Cloud VMs to show the multitenant overhead is small.
dbi-services:fixed-table-automatic-stati: Shows that 12c's automatic statistics job now gathers fixed-object (X$) statistics by default, contradicting an Oracle white paper written before this behavior was implemented.
dbi-services:creer-une-base-oracle-sur-l: Walks through a French-language video creating an Oracle DBaaS trial account, subscription, and VM from scratch, covering the roughly hour-long waits for approval and provisioning.
dbi-services:lost-in-the-cloud-my-cloud-: Distinguishes the Oracle Cloud 'My Account' company-level subscription dashboard from the 'My Services' administrator console used for provisioning and monitoring, and how to navigate between them.
dbi-services:cloning-a-pdb-to-the-oracle: Shows using SSH remote port forwarding to expose an on-premises database's listener port to an Oracle Public Cloud VM, enabling a database link for remote-cloning a PDB into the cloud CDB.
dbi-services:how-to-check-multitenant-op: Runs DBMS_FEATURE_USAGE_INTERNAL.EXEC_DB_USAGE_SAMPLING manually and queries DBA_FEATURE_USAGE_STATISTICS to show even a single-tenant database records usage under 'Oracle Pluggable Databases'.
dbi-services:rac-to-ron-then-ron-to-rac-: Warns that converting a policy-managed RAC database with a singleton service to RAC One Node and back to RAC silently changes that service's cardinality from SINGLETON to UNIFORM.
dbi-services:rman-12c-push-and-pull-dupl: Compares RMAN log output between 12c's default pull-based duplicate, where auxiliary channels connect to the target, and push-based duplicate forced by specifying 'using copy'.
dbi-services:12c-multitenant-pdb-spfile-: Shows that PDB-level spfile parameters are stored in the CDB$ROOT table SYS.PDB_SPFILE$ keyed by PDB_UID, explaining why changing them on a read-only standby needs a different approach.
dbi-services:the-privileges-to-connect-t: Uses DBMS_PRIVILEGE_CAPTURE against a DBA-granted role in both CDB$ROOT and a PDB to identify the two separate privileges that must be revoked to fully prevent connecting to a container.
dbi-services:12c-multitenant-internals-a: Shows that AWR's DBA_HIST_ tables and views are not themselves Object Links, but the switch to CDB$ROOT happens through an intermediate INT$ view like INT$DBA_HIST_SYSSTAT.
dbi-services:12c-multitenant-cursor-shar: Compares library cache contention between 3000-schema consolidation on a 10g database and 50-PDB multitenant consolidation, running the same simulated connection-pool script across 50 sessions.
dbi-services:conversion-to-flex-asm-with: Shows converting a two-node RAC cluster to Flex ASM using ASMCA's convert button, with the underlying script completing in five minutes and enabling a per-node ASM listener afterward.
dbi-services:any-reason-to-change-the-c-: Shows changing common_user_prefix from C## to OPS$ so an externally-authenticated common user can connect without a password from the matching OS account, via a local bequeath connection.
dbi-services:resource-manager-plan-from-: Maps each OEM Resource Manager plan GUI field, like Utilization limit % and shares, to its corresponding DBMS_RESOURCE_MANAGER.CREATE_PLAN_DIRECTIVE argument, noting deprecated names OEM still uses.
